subtopics.title: Summit Theme, Principles and Objectives
subtopics.summary: India hosted the India AI Impact Summit 2026 at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi, presented as the first multilateral AI summit in the Global South. The summit marked a shift from a Western safety-first model to an impact-first, developmental approach to AI, under the theme 'Sarvajana Hitaya, Sarvajana Sukhaya'. Its work rests on three Sutras and seven Chakras, and it set out four key objectives.
facts: Held at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi; described as the 1st multilateral AI summit in the Global South
Signals a shift from a Western safety-first model to an impact-first, developmental AI paradigm
Theme: 'Sarvajana Hitaya, Sarvajana Sukhaya' (Welfare for All, Happiness for All)
3 Sutras: People (Inclusive Development), Planet (Ethical Innovation), Progress (Sustainable Societal Impact)
7 Chakras (Priority Cooperation Areas): Healthcare, Agriculture, Education, Governance, Climate action, Digital Economy, Social Inclusion
Objective 1: translate global AI discussions into development outcomes aligned with IndiaAI Mission and Digital India
Objective 2: promote responsible and ethical AI, addressing algorithmic bias, privacy protection and accountability
Objective 3: build partnerships between governments, startups, academia and industry
Objective 4: position India as a Global AI Hub and promote an indigenous AI ecosystem
Switzerland will host the 2027 World Summit on AI in Geneva

subtopics.title: M.A.N.A.V. Roadmap and Previous AI Summits
subtopics.summary: The Prime Minister unveiled the human-centric M.A.N.A.V. Framework for Ethical and Inclusive AI at the summit, with each letter standing for one principle. The booklet also traces earlier global AI summits: the UK's 1st AI Safety Summit and its Bletchley Declaration, the Seoul Summit of 2024 and the 3rd AI Action Summit held in Paris in 2025.
facts: Prime Minister unveiled the human-centric M.A.N.A.V. Framework for Ethical and Inclusive AI at the summit
M: Moral and Ethical Systems; AI must be fair and transparent, subject to human oversight
A: Accountable Governance; clear institutional responsibility, transparent regulatory rules, strong oversight
N: National Sovereignty; securing critical datasets, strengthening domestic compute, indigenous model development
A: Accessible and Inclusive AI; democratise benefits, bridge the digital divide, reach marginalised populations
V: Valid and Legitimate Systems; trust, safety and legal compliance, important given deepfakes and misinformation
UK hosted the 1st AI Safety Summit and adopted the Bletchley Declaration on AI's promises and risks
Bletchley Declaration emphasises aligning AI with human intent, safeguarding rights, safety, ethics and accountability
AI Seoul Summit took place in 2024, co-hosted by the Republic of Korea and the UK government
3rd AI Action Summit was held in 2025 in Paris, France

subtopics.title: Sovereign Models and Domain Platforms
subtopics.summary: India's sovereign AI models include Sarvam's large language models, the Vikram chatbot, Gnani.ai's Vachana speech model and BharatGen's Param2 17B. Bharat GenAI develops foundational models tailored to 22 Indian languages, while BODH, SAHI, VoicERA and BHASHINI cover health and language platforms. The Bio-AI Mulankur Hubs link AI with biotechnology under the BioE3 policy.
facts: Sarvam-30B and Sarvam-105B by Sarvam AI are large language models that generate human-like text
Sarvam's Vikram is a multilingual chatbot for seamless conversations across Indian languages
Vachana is a text-to-speech model by Gnani.ai that supports 12 Indian languages
Param2 17B is a multilingual foundational AI model by BharatGen
Bharat GenAI: India's first government-supported initiative for sovereign foundational AI models, spearheaded by IIT Bombay
Bharat GenAI models are tailored to 22 Indian languages and cover text, text-to-speech and vision-language
BODH: privacy-preserving benchmarking platform for health AI using diverse, real-world health data; positioned under Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission
SAHI (Strategy for Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare for India): national framework for responsible AI integration in healthcare
VoicERA: open-source, end-to-end voice AI stack serving as a national execution layer for multilingual voice AI
BHASHINI (Bhasha Interface for India): AI-powered national language translation and speech platform under Digital India
